definitions.explanation: a machine used for printing text or images onto paper or other materials

examples.japanese: {印刷機|いんさつき}が{動|うご}いている{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of the printing press running.

examples.japanese: グーテンベルクの{印刷機|いんさつき}は{世界|せかい}を{変|か}えた。
examples.english: Gutenberg's printing press changed the world.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}に{新型|しんがた}の{印刷機|いんさつき}を{導入|どうにゅう}したことで、{生産|せいさん}{効率|こうりつ}が{大幅|おおはば}に{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: By introducing a new model of printing press at the factory, production efficiency increased significantly.

notes:
A machine that reproduces text and images on paper. Composed of {印刷|いんさつ} (printing) + {機|き} (machine). Covers everything from traditional letterpress machines to modern industrial printing equipment. Not typically used for home/office printers, which are called プリンター.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {印刷機|いんさつき}を{回|まわ}す — to run the printing press
- {印刷機|いんさつき}を{導入|どうにゅう}する — to install a printing press
- {大型|おおがた}{印刷機|いんさつき} — large-scale printing press
- オフセット{印刷機|いんさつき} — offset printing press

TYPES:
- {活版|かっぱん}{印刷機|いんさつき} — letterpress printing machine
- オフセット{印刷機|いんさつき} — offset printing machine
- デジタル{印刷機|いんさつき} — digital printing machine
- {輪転|りんてん}{印刷機|いんさつき} — rotary printing press (for newspapers and mass production)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プリンター — printer (home/office desktop printer)
- {印刷所|いんさつじょ} — print shop, printing office
- {複合機|ふくごうき} — multifunction printer (print/scan/copy)
